description:
Configure OrientDB's Lucene full-text search engine and perform search queries. 

1. Connect to the 'demodb' database (user: admin, pass: admin).
2. Create a Lucene FULLTEXT index on the 'Name' property of the 'Hotels' class.
3. Create a Lucene FULLTEXT index on the 'Name' property of the 'Restaurants' class.
4. Perform the following search queries and export the results to a single JSON file at `/home/ga/Documents/fulltext_search_results.json`:
   - 'palace_plaza_hotels': Hotels containing 'Palace' OR 'Plaza'
   - 'trattoria_restaurants': Restaurants containing 'Trattoria'
   - 'luxury_chain_hotels': Hotels containing 'Hyatt' OR 'Four Seasons'

The JSON file must have the three keys listed above, each containing an array of the matching records.
